name: playwright-e2e-test
description: Daraz Login Automation - Playwright E2E Tests

scripts.daraz-login: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEST_FLOW_NAME='daraz-login'; npx playwright test tests/tests/login.spec.ts --headed --workers=1"
scripts.daraz-login-headless: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEST_FLOW_NAME='daraz-login-headless'; npx playwright test tests/tests/login.spec.ts --workers=1"
scripts.daraz-full-flow: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEST_FLOW_NAME='daraz-full-flow'; npx playwright test tests/tests/fullFlow.spec.ts --headed --workers=1"
scripts.daraz-full-flow-headless: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEST_FLOW_NAME='daraz-full-flow-headless'; npx playwright test tests/tests/fullFlow.spec.ts --workers=1"
scripts.report:playwright:merge: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR='reports/playwright/combined-html'; npx playwright merge-reports --reporter html reports/playwright/flow-wise/blob"

author: Anisur Rahman Tonu
